laws.rule: Aguascalientes bans selling and drinking alcohol on public roads, in parks and in public squares, unless an authorised venue operates there; events may be authorised by the council (Ley que regula la Venta y Consumo de Bebidas Alcohólicas, art. 19). Venues must stop selling and serving on election days set by federal and state electoral law, and on days a council orders for safety (art. 22). Venues may not serve under-18s even when with an adult (art. 10). The text on OJN is the 2001 publication; later reforms were not checked.

items.text: The Ley que regula la venta y consumo de bebidas alcohólicas en el Estado de Aguascalientes (congress compilation last updated 26 May 2025) requires licensees to refuse sale or consumption to minors and to uniformed police or soldiers (art. 9 XI). Article 10 II also forbids selling or allowing consumption by minors even when they are accompanied by an adult, and forbids letting them into cantinas, beer halls, cabarets, nightclubs, botaneros, pulquerías, bars, discos and similar venues, except at events where no alcoholic drinks are sold or consumed. Article 13 also bans consumption by minors at club or banquet-hall events, including private events. The law says menores de edad and does not itself define that age.

Article 19 bans the sale and consumption of alcoholic drinks in streets, parks and public squares, unless an authorised establishment is already there. Kermesses or special events in those places may be authorised under the law's regulation and the applicable municipal rules. No licence or permit is to be granted for sale or consumption in prisons, welfare institutions, hospitals, clinics, schools and similar places. Licensees must also not use the public street for the business of the venue (art. 9 X).
Article 20 leaves the opening hours of the venues listed in article 11 to the municipal councils. This law does not itself set statewide clock hours.

psychoactive-substances.notes: This is state law on licensed sale and consumption. The text read uses menores de edad and does not itself state 18 years. Councils set hours. Official compilation last updated 26 May 2025.
